messages:
jade: Quick check-in  were finalizing Friday's announcement. Need eng to lock changelog URL + exact canary window. Target publish Fri 09:00 PT. Any last-minute blockers?

tom: I can land the canonical links today. Marketing wants a single short landing URL that redirects to release-notes + migration checklist + webinar anchor.

ella: I'll build that redirect and add anchors: #whats-new, #migration, #webinar. Also adding a 3-bullet "what's changed" for the header.

sam: Canary plan proposal: 15m canary at 09:00 PT -> gradual ramp to 50% over 45m -> hold 60m -> full at +2h if green. Auto-fallback if 5xx > 0.2% over 5m or p95 latency increases >12%. Ops will monitor.

jade: Marketing needs: 1) two subject lines for 12h A/B test 2) one-line tweet copy 3) 25-30s webinar blurb. Can we get those by EOD?

tom: Subject A: "New rollout controls for safer, cheaper LLM inference"
Subject B: "Ship LLM features faster  canary tooling + migration guides"
Tweet: "Reduce inference risk and unit cost with smarter batching, KV cache, and targeted canaries. Read + register: https://events.redwood.ai/nov2024"

ella: Webinar blurb: "Join our live demo where we show canary rollout, rollback triggers, and migration guidance. Fri 09:00 PT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 KST. Register: https://events.redwood.ai/nov2024"

sam: Inbound routing  marketing form should tag region and campaign so Sales can route. Suggest headers: X-Region, X-UTM-Campaign. Example payload from eng-ops-bot:
```http
POST /api/register
Headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Region": "NA", "X-UTM-Campaign": "nov-announce"}
Body: {"email":"alex@example.com","name":"Alex","company":"Acme"}
```

eng-ops-bot: infra-bot: staging form updated with header passthrough. Routing map sample: NA->sdr-na, EMEA->sdr-emea, APAC->sdr-apac. If inbound >100/day for any region, forward to growth@.

jade: Nice. Also need a 2-line migration snippet for the post and the docs callout. Keep it simple.

ella: Migration snippet: "1) Pin current model/version before upgrade. 2) Start with 10% canary traffic; verify p95 & 5xx thresholds, then ramp."

tom: Final changelog (will be live by 5pm PT): https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2024-11/changelog.html. I'll drop the commit hash when pushed. PD: eng-oncall -> tom, eng-sre -> riley. Reminder ping set for 08:40 PT.

jade: Marketing will assemble assets (tweet, A/B subjects, header image, short migration bullets). I'll post the final announce doc to #announce and schedule the send for Fri 09:00 PT. Thanks all :rocket:

tom: thumbsup
ella: :sparkles:
eng-ops-bot: infra-bot: scheduled canary: 2024-11-15T09:00:00-08:00 -> canary_end 09:15, ramp 09:15-10:00, hold until 11:00, full 11:00. Reminder at 08:45 PT.
